data.name: Sumayr
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Sumayr means 'a fragrant garden' or 'a sweet smelling flower'. In Islamic tradition, it is derived from the word 'sumar', which refers to a kind of palm tree that bears sweet-smelling fruit.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beauty of Allah's creation and the radiance of the believer's faith

in_arabic.name: سمير
in_arabic.meaning: اسمير يعني الشخص الذي له عيون زرقاء أو خضرا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سمير مشتق من الجذر العربي (س-م-ر) والذي يعني اللون الأزرق أو الأخضر، ويرتبط بالعينين. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة والنادرة في العالم العربي، حيث يوحي بالجمال والطبيعة.

in_urdu.name: سمیر
in_urdu.meaning: سمیر کا مطلب ہے کسی ایسے شخص کا نام جو آسمان یا سمندر جیسے رنگوں سے جڑا ہوا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: سمیر نام کی اصطلاح عربی زبان کے جڑ (س-م-ر) سے نکلی ہے، جو آسمان یا سمندر کے رنگوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، خاص طور پر نیلا یا سبز رنگ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، اور اس کا ذکر خوبصورتی اور روحانی اہمیت کے ساتھ کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सुमैर
in_hindi.meaning: सुमैर का अर्थ है किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति का नाम जो आंखों के रंग से संबंधित है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुमैर नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल (स-म-र) से हुई है, जो आंखों के रंगों को दर्शाता है, विशेष रूप से नीला या हरा। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, और इसकी सुंदरता और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के लिए जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: سمير
in_pashto.meaning: سمير د يو چا د نوم چې د سترګو رنگ يې نیول یا شین وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: سمير نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښې (س-م-ر) څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د سترګو رنگونه ښايي، په ځانګړي ډول نيول يا شين. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديزې کې مشهور دی، او د هغه د ښکلا او روحاني اهميت لپاره يادونه کیږي.

in_english.name: Sumayr
in_english.meaning: Sumayr means a person with blue or green eyes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sumayr is derived from the Arabic root (s-m-r), which signifies the colors blue or green, often associated with the eyes. This name has historical significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing beauty, serenity, and a connection to nature. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a rich cultural heritage.

data.cultural_impact: Sumayr is a beautiful and evocative name with deep cultural roots in the Arab and Islamic world. The Arabic language has always been known for its poetic and expressive nature, and Sumayr is a perfect embodiment of this tradition. It conveys a sense of beauty, fragility, and optimism, symbolizing the richness and depth of Islamic culture and history. The name is reminiscent of gardens, oasis, and lush greenery, which are significant features of Middle Eastern landscapes and a central theme in Islamic art and literature. Furthermore, the name Sumayr reflects the importance of nature and its connection to human spirituality in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Sumayr, as a name associated with a fragrant garden or sweet-smelling flower, has significant spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It reflects the idea of the garden as a symbol of Paradise, wherein Muslims believe they will reside after death. The garden is also a metaphor for the human soul, which is supported by faith, good deeds, and knowledge, and blossoms into its full potential. The sweet-smelling fruit of the palm tree, which is the literal source of the name Sumayr, also symbolizes the fruit of good deeds and the sweetness of spiritual growth and enlightenment. Thus, the name Sumayr serves as a reminder of the religious and spiritual values of beauty, nature, growth, and the pursuit of knowledge and good deeds.
